verdict.rationale: Docs show the pieces needed: agents can draft emails and segments via AI/MCP (docs-16, docs-31), broadcasts are queued and sent at a specified time rather than immediately (docs-13), and the MCP server explicitly separates reads from writes/deletes so a human can approve each action category independently (docs-10, docs-27). However there is no single documented end-to-end example showing an agent drafting a campaign against a segment and leaving it queued specifically pending human approval before send. Missing for 10: an explicit worked example/tutorial combining segment targeting + draft + scheduled hold for approval, and independent/hands-on corroboration of this exact workflow.
